Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic production-quality UI for the MOBILE number-selection completion/share screen of an existing Chinese Double Color number picker. Target design dimensions 390 x 844, portrait, app content only: no phone bezel, no OS/status bar/browser chrome. Current date is 2026-10-18; sample timestamp 2026.10.18 10:30. SINGLE INDEPENDENT CONCEPT, not a collage. Keep existing refined collectible toy visual language, glossy porcelain/resin 3D Caishen, champagne gold, cream paper #fff8eb, warm brown #43291f and coral #ff656b, studio-lit craftsmanship. Input image 1 is a NEGATIVE HIERARCHY reference: the user specifically rejects its huge '我的选号单' header, redundant app-brand text, filler slogan, machine thumbnail and wasted space. REMOVE that whole informational header approach. No machine artwork anywhere in the result. Input image 2 is the exact existing mascot identity to preserve: full proportion, happy bearded god with black-and-gold hat, scarlet gold-cloud robe, golden ingot; feature this original recognizable 3D character prominently, do not flatten to vector or replace with a different deity. Images 3 and 4 are actual glossy red/blue number-ball material references. User priority: BIG MASCOT + ITS SPOKEN BLESSING, then clear six red numbers and one blue number with believable lottery-paper ticket / detachable stub details. The role and quote are the emotional hero, not a generic heading. Exact quote: '这组号码本神罩着，财运给你撑腰。' Can break it into 2-3 emphatic lines. Role name '财神爷' small and subordinate. Exact red numbers '07 08 21 26 29 30', blue '15'. Include tactile off-white paper, tiny printed time and identifier 'XY-1018-0018', genuine perforation line with circular tear notches, a restrained decorative barcode on the actual stub. Tiny but legible label '仅供模拟选号 · 非真实彩票' plus '角色祝福不改变概率' on paper/footer. No real lottery logos, sales amount, winnings, official draw period, or claims made outside the attributed mascot speech. One clear bottom primary action '保存图片', secondary '分享好运', and small close × top-right. Avoid giant title '我的选号单', redundant '这一组送给今天的你' or invented navigation/metrics/badges. Prioritize whitespace, hierarchy, material quality and clean readable Chinese typography; no crammed cards inside cards, no gratuitous extra features. Real implementable product screen, orthographic straight-on paper; do not warp typography or squash mascot. All core content and bottom actions visible without scrolling.
Direction name: Guardian's blessing slip. Composition: a joyful large FULL-BODY original Caishen centered in the upper 44% of the portrait page, feet and hat intact, occupying about 250px height, subtle warm golden halo and only a few polished gold sparkles to suggest a game reward. Directly under or beside the lower part of the mascot, the quoted blessing is the MAIN typography in confident warm brown, about 26px equivalent, with a small '财神爷' attribution. No generic title above it. Lower 32% is a SINGLE compact cream lottery-paper horizontal receipt with crisp gold edge, six glossy red number balls plus one glossy blue ball in one readable row, tiny '双色球 · 单式选号'. Beneath a true perforation line is a short ticket stub with time, ID and decorative barcode. The receipt is much smaller than the original top-heavy card; mascot and character speech feel like the prize. Keep the bottom save/share actions in one clean row outside the shareable art; creamy page base, not dark backdrop. Graceful aligned breathing space, strong friendly character presence and a premium tactile keepsake.

Direction name: Signed by the wealth god. A distinctly different ASYMMETRIC editorial lottery ticket composition. One tall actual CREAM PAPER TICKET fills the central mobile screen, with torn top edge, small side notches and tangible paper fiber; the share buttons sit outside it below. NOT the generic 'mascot centered above quote above separate card' layout. Inside the ticket's upper half: the original full Caishen stands large on the LEFT, around 45% of the ticket width, slightly overlapping the paper's left edge like a dimensional die-cut figure. On the RIGHT, the character's statement is a gorgeous bold typographic quote, staggered into 4 short warm-brown lines: '这组号码 / 本神罩着， / 财运给你 / 撑腰。' A very small '财神爷' with fine gold line acts as signature beside his ingot, not a section heading. Strong lively diagonal gold brush accent UNDER the final quote line, not over the letters. Mascot and quote visually talk to each other and share one hierarchy, filling about the upper 50% together. In the LOWER paper half, a clean compact '双色球 · 单式选号' label and one row of SEVEN readable glossy balls: red07 red08 red21 red26 red29 red30 blue15. Under this, a prominent authentic detachable ticket STUB with a horizontal perforation line, half-circle side notches, small date and ID, decorative barcode and a tilted coral ink stamp reading '财神护财'. Fit the actual quote exactly, no additional slogans, no large app title, NO machine illustration. Use generous optical alignment and refined negative space. Restrained game collectible feel through physical layering and stamp, not a poster full of coins. Same original character and cream/gold/red materials. Bottom '保存图片' primary and '分享好运' secondary remain easy to reach. Close × in upper-right margin.

Direction name: Fortune collector ticket. Make a VERY DISTINCT game-reward collectible design, still the same sophisticated cream/gold toy material family. Primary object is ONE vertical souvenir ticket with a physical detachable NARROW STUB ON ITS RIGHT SIDE, divided by a VERTICAL perforation, circular notches at the top and bottom of that seam. This vertical right-hand stub is the recognizable differentiator from the other designs. Mobile screen 390x844 content-only, calm creamy page with warm coral-red accent glow and a few restrained embossed gold corner ornaments. Main ticket about 335px wide including a 42px right stub, a sculpted champagne-gold frame with cream porcelain/paper inner surface, not an ornate medieval fantasy UI. At the very TOP of the main ticket, the role's exact quote is the hero: '这组号码本神罩着，财运给你撑腰。' in 3 balanced powerful lines, dark warm brown with a few coral emphasis words. Tiny attribution '财神爷' beneath, NO '我的选号单' heading. The original glossy Caishen stands LARGE in the CENTER of the main ticket, front-on complete head-to-feet, holding the ingot, gold light ring behind him and two subtle dimensional corner flourishes. Its full shape stays within the main content and does not overlap the thin right stub. At the BOTTOM of the main ticket, the six red numbers 07 08 21 26 29 30 and blue15 appear on glossy ball medallions, set in TWO staggered rows for big legible numbers: first row red07 red08 red21, second row red26 red29 red30 with the blue15 slightly raised to their right in its own blue accented position. Clearly 6 RED + 1 BLUE, no repeated or extra numbers. Small '双色球 · 单式选号' printed near the ball group. The entire RIGHT detachable stub has tiny vertical time '2026.10.18 10:30', ID 'XY-1018-0018' and a vertical decorative barcode. This feels like a limited keepsake photo card attached to a real lottery-paper stub, with the character as the prize. Tiny simulation and probability disclaimer along main paper bottom. Below the object, one coral raised '保存图片' action and a lighter '分享好运' action, no extra menus. Small close × upper-right margin. Strong typography, sharp 3D material, restrained flourishes, obvious collectible artifact / right stub structure. No machine thumbnail, no generic top banner, no information metadata panel.
